theme: Open water, with landfall to arrange
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is clear and you're still on the charter, so today's real work is the short stack of bookings that put you back on Florida ground smoothly come Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat landing logistics still open
needsAttention.detail: You're off the boat Friday noon at Komolac — the transfer to Cavtat, the hotel bag hold, and Sunday's ~5:15 AM express checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from dry land before Saturday, since connectivity is thin underway. p1, overdue Sep 9.

needsAttention.title: Last call on the St Pete Airbnb
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking charges tomorrow, Sept 18; any switch to a better rate or spot has to happen today. p3, overdue Sep 15.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA car and the gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 — the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV and the Sept 20–21 St Pete nights are both still unbooked; don't arrive jet-lagged on a Sunday to walk-up rates. Two p1s, overdue.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south in October, so there's no six-seater in Maine for Christmas; a refundable full-size SUV out of PWM sells out early over the holiday. p1, overdue Sep 14.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club intro forming
flagged.detail: Mark Lubrano is lining up a Mercer/Marsh intro with Chie Mitsui; you're cc'd, nothing owed yet.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the Adriatic has you until the charter wraps Friday.
The only real work is landside: the Cavtat transfers and Sunday's Florida landing.
The girls are with Jen through the 21st, so the evening is entirely your own.
